docs/shots/m4-credential-prompt-and-hints.txt
what right looks like: Capture header "Judge by eye": password field shows a masked row of a fixed 8 glyphs, never the typed length and never the plaintext; username field shows the plaintext ("alice") — only password/token fields mask; box stays centred, borders intact, note row dimmed text present.
================================================================================

# TestBackend captures (not a pty), no colour recorded — ticket m4-remotes/03
# (footer placement fixed after a merge regression: see NOTES in the ticket;
# this file regenerated in the M4 group 03 review fix round — TOO_SMALL
# shortened and centred, the 156/144 threshold corrected, a confirm-box
# capture added).
#
# Credential prompt: `cargo test -p graft-ui --lib
# credential_prompt::tests::capture_for_docs_shots -- --ignored --nocapture`
# (crates/graft-ui/src/credential_prompt/tests.rs).
# Confirm box: `cargo test -p graft-ui --lib
# confirm::tests::capture_for_docs_shots -- --ignored --nocapture`
# (crates/graft-ui/src/confirm.rs).
# Footer hints: the literal committed snapshots at
# crates/graft-ui/src/graph_screen/snapshots/*footer-hints-{80,120}.snap,
# plus 144/155/200 cols from `graph_screen::tests::footer_at` (not
# snapshotted — read here instead).
#
# Judge by eye:
# - Password field shows a **fixed 8** glyphs, whatever the real length
#   (ADR-0038 §2, m5-history-and-ghost-preview/01 — the field itself is now
#   `graft_ui::text_input::SecretField`, a zeroizing buffer). This capture
#   is the widget drawn from a hand-built view with the pulse bit **down**
#   (`secret: Some(false)` in `credential_prompt::tests::password_prompt`),
#   so all 8 read `•`. With the pulse up the first glyph is `◦` — see
#   docs/shots/m4-credential-prompt-in-app.txt, the same box over a real
#   push with a 7-character password in the field, also 8 glyphs wide.
#   Earlier revisions of this caption said a password was typed here: it
#   never was.
#   Read the first glyph as "a key landed", never as a length. It flips on
#   every edit, and it starts from a random bit drawn afresh for each
#   prompt (`graft::jobs::askpass::pulse_seed`), so which of the two rows
#   a field rests at is the seed's doing, not the password's: the same
#   password draws this row in half its prompts and the `◦` row in the
#   other half. The two halves of ADR-0038 §2 are proved by
#   `graft_ui::text_input::tests::every_keystroke_visibly_changes_the_
#   masked_row` (every keystroke moves exactly one cell) and
#   `..::the_resting_row_is_decided_by_the_seed_not_the_length` (3
#   characters and 30 rest at the same two rows, one per seed).
#   What that does not hide: someone watching this screen from the moment
#   the prompt opened can count the flips.
#   No cursor column is drawn for a secret field (it would leak the caret
#   position, which does track length) — the cursor row disappears entirely
#   rather than showing a fixed position, and this capture can't show the
#   reversed-cell style a normal field's cursor would use in any case
#   (CLAUDE.md rule 5: captures can't prove colour).
# - Username field shows the plaintext ("alice") — only password/token
#   fields mask.
# - Box stays centred, borders intact, note row dimmed text present, footer
#   hint baked into the bottom border.
# - Below 40 cols / 7 rows: one centred line ("too small for the prompt"),
#   no plaintext leaked, no box. Shortened from the original wording, which
#   was itself wider than the fallback ever draws at — it was always cut.
# - Confirm box: title, the consequence wrapped on spaces (capped at 4
#   lines, `…` past that), a blank line, the exact git command, buttons with
#   `Cancel` bracketed by default. Colour (which button is "selected") is
#   unverified here for the same reason as the masked field's cursor.
# - Footer: `f fetch  p pull  P push` sit after `H hide stash`, before
#   `J journal` — the mockup's position (design note "New UI"), not ahead of
#   `/ search`/`j/k move`. They first fit together at 144 columns; `J
#   journal` joins eleven columns later, at 155. Below 144 they drop with
#   the rest of the trailing hints, and at 80 columns the daily footer is
#   unchanged from before this ticket.

=== credential prompt: masked password, 80x24 ===
"    ╭ Credentials — 127.0.0.1:8443─────────────────────────────────────────╮"
"    │ Password for 'http://user@127.0.0.1:8443':                           │"
"    │ ▏••••••••                                                            │"
"    │ typed here only · never stored by Graft                              │"
"    ╰ ⏎ send  ⌃U clear  esc cancel the push────────────────────────────────╯"

=== credential prompt: plaintext username, 160x48 ===
"                                            ╭ Credentials — github.com─────────────────────────────────────────────╮"
"                                            │ Username for 'https://github.com':                                   │"
"                                            │ ▏alice                                                               │"
"                                            │ typed here only · never stored by Graft                              │"
"                                            ╰ ⏎ send  ⌃U clear  esc cancel the push────────────────────────────────╯"

=== credential prompt: too small, 30x5 (centred, whole message) ===
"   too small for the prompt"

=== confirm box: push, two-line consequence, 80x24 ===
"        Push main → origin/main"
"        2 commits · sets upstream · can't be undone from here — origin"
"        keeps what you send"
"        git push --progress -u origin refs/heads/main:refs/heads/main"
"        [ Cancel ]     Discard"

=== confirm box: push, one-line consequence, 160x48 ===
"                                                Push main → origin/main"
"                                                can't be undone from here — origin keeps what you send"
"                                                git push --progress origin main"
"                                                [ Cancel ]     Discard"

=== confirm box: long push consequence at 120x9 (confirm::tests::buttons_stay_above_footer_at_120) ===
# asserts area.bottom() < frame.bottom() and area.height == frame.height - 1
# at 120x9 and 120x6 — a frame at or below the box's own row budget, so the
# footer-row reservation (M3 review 06 Minor 11) actually has to act. The
# previous version of this test used a 120x40 frame the 9-row box could
# never reach regardless of the reservation (M4 group 03 review Major 4).

=== graph screen footer, 80 cols (footer-hints-80.snap) — unchanged by this ticket ===
q quit  F2 status  F3 renderer  u undo  / search  j/k move  Space fold

=== graph screen footer, 120 cols (footer-hints-120.snap) — remote hints don't fit yet ===
q quit  F2 status  F3 renderer  u undo  / search  j/k move  Space fold  1 first-parent  F focus  S stash  H hide stash

=== graph screen footer, 144 cols (first width all three remote hints survive) ===
q quit  F2 status  F3 renderer  u undo  / search  j/k move  Space fold  1 first-parent  F focus  S stash  H hide stash  f fetch  p pull  P push

=== graph screen footer, 155 cols (J journal joins) ===
q quit  F2 status  F3 renderer  u undo  / search  j/k move  Space fold  1 first-parent  F focus  S stash  H hide stash  f fetch  p pull  P push  J journal

=== graph screen footer, 200 cols ===
q quit  F2 status  F3 renderer  u undo  / search  j/k move  Space fold  1 first-parent  F focus  S stash  H hide stash  f fetch  p pull  P push  J journal  y sha  PgUp/PgDn page  g/G top/bottom

what right looks like: Capture header "Judge by eye": the box is centred over the screen, the title names the host (not the user), git's own question is on the first line, the field shows the masked count and no plaintext, the note says the answer is never stored, the footer says what ⏎, ⌃U and Esc do — Esc naming the push it cancels. (Re-taken by m6-conflicts/78, after 69: the border ends `esc cancel push main → origin/main`, the push by name; the bottom row is the prompt's keys, `⏎ send  esc cancel`, in every frame.)
================================================================================

# m4-credential-prompt-in-app.txt: TestBackend captures (not a pty), no
# colour recorded. Fixture: capture_m4_credential_prompt_in_app in
# crates/graft/src/view/tests.rs (asserted; regenerate on purpose).
# The prompt as it appears *in the app*, over a running push — the widget on
# its own is docs/shots/m4-credential-prompt-and-hints.txt.
#
# Judge by eye:
# 1. 120x40, password ask with a 7-character password typed: the box is centred over the
#    screen, the title names the host (not the user), git's own question is
#    on the first line, the field shows a fixed 8 mask glyphs (never the
#    typed length, ADR-0038 §2) and no plaintext, the note says the answer
#    is never stored, and the box's bottom border says what ⏎, ⌃U and Esc
#    do, ending `esc cancel push main → origin/main`: the push it cancels,
#    by name (m6-conflicts/78). The bottom row is the prompt's own keys,
#    `⏎ send  esc cancel`, in every frame: the push's running line waits
#    under it and comes back once the prompt is answered (m6-conflicts/69).
# 2. The same 7-character password again, with the prompt's pulse seed the
#    other way up. The first mask glyph differs between 1 and 2 and nothing
#    else does. That is the whole of ADR-0038 §2: the glyph flips on every
#    keystroke so a key visibly lands, and where it rests is decided by a
#    random bit drawn per prompt (`graft::jobs::askpass::pulse_seed`), not
#    by the length — so a screenshot of either row says nothing about how
#    long the password is. Both rows are 8 glyphs wide.
#    It does not hide the length from somebody who watches the row from the
#    moment the prompt opens and counts the flips.
# 3. 80x24, username ask with `alice` typed: the same box, the answer in the
#    open (a username is not a secret), no `•` anywhere.
#
=== 120x40 · password · pulse seed down ===

================================================================================
docs/shots/m4-remote-keys.txt
what right looks like: Capture header "Judge by eye": the lease box names the tip it expects and the one it sends, says it is refused if origin moved since the fetch, says whose history it rewrites, shows the exact git command, `[ Cancel ]` is under the cursor with `Force push` beside it; the footer while `f` runs shows the operation, git's own progress, and how to stop it (`esc cancels`).
================================================================================

# m4-remote-keys.txt: TestBackend capture (not a pty), 120x40, no colour
# recorded. Fixture: capture_m4_remote_keys in crates/graft/src/view/tests.rs
# (asserted; regenerate on purpose). Two screens.
#
# 1. `P` after git refused a push as not a fast-forward: the lease box.
#    Judge by eye: it names the tip it expects (9f8e7d6) and the one it
#    sends, says it is refused if origin moved since the fetch, says whose
#    history it rewrites, shows the exact git command, and `[ Cancel ]` is
#    under the cursor with `Force push` beside it.
# 2. The footer while `f` runs: the operation, git's own progress, and how
#    to stop it (`esc cancels`).
#
" graft 3 commits                                                                                                        "
"◌ ▏  Uncommitted changes (1 staged, 2 unstaged, 1 untracked)                                                            "
"◆    [HEAD] Commit 3␛[31m                                                                                TE 57y  0303030"
"●    Commit 2␛[31m                                                                                       TE 57y  0202020"
"◇    Commit 1␛[31m                                                                                       TE 57y  0101010"
"                                                                                                                        "
"                                                                                                                        "
"     ╭ Force-push main → origin/main? ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮                 "
"     │ origin/main 9f8e7d6 → 0303030 · refused if origin moved since your fetch (lease)               │                 "
"     │ rewrites history for everyone who has 9f8e7d6                                                  │                 "
"     │ nothing on origin/main is lost                                                                 │                 "
"     │                                                                                                │                 "
"     │ git push --progress --force-with-lease=refs/heads/main:9f8e7d6c5b4a39281706f5e4d3c2b1a0987654… │                 "
"     │                                                                                                │                 "
"     │ ▸[ Cancel ]   [ Force push ]                                                                   │                 "
"     ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯                 "
"                                                                                                                        "
"                                                                                                                        "
"                                                                                                                        "
"                                                                                                                        "
"                                                                                                                        "
"                                                                                                                        "
"                                                                                                                        "
" ←/→ move  ⏎ choose  esc cancel                                                                                         "
"UNCOMMITTED · 1 staged 2 unstaged 1 untracked                                                                           "
"diff vs HEAD 0303030                                                                                                    "
"STAGED (1)                    fn routes()                                                                               "
"  ▾ src/                       18  18       let mut app = Router::new();                                                "
"    ▾ auth/                    19     -     app.get("/health", health);                                                 "
"      M token.rs       +12 −4      19▎+     app.get("/health", health);                                                 "
"UNSTAGED (2)                       20 +     app.get("/ready", ready);                                                   "
"  ▾ src/                       20  21       app                                                                         "
"    ▾ api/                     21  22   }                                                                               "
"      M routes.rs       +3 −2 fn ready()                                                                                "
"    ▾ auth/                    44  45   async fn ready() -> Json<Status> {                                              "
"      M token.rs        +2 −0  45     -     Json(Status::Ok)                                                            "
"UNTRACKED (1)                      46 +     Json(Status::from(&state))                                                  "
"  ? notes.md            +0 −0  46  47   }                                                                               "
"                                                                                                                        "
"                                                                                                                        "
